data.description:
Two agent-surface honesty defects, both live, both small.

1. THE OPENAPI DESCRIPTION MAKES A CLAIM THE SPEC DISPROVES. GET https://marquee.stage11.dev/api/openapi.json -> info.description says verbatim: 'Mutations carry strong ETag/If-Match optimistic concurrency.' Counted from the served document: 'If-Match' occurs EXACTLY ONCE in the whole 389KB spec — and that occurrence IS this sentence. There are 116 mutating operations and ZERO header parameters across all 194 operations. The real coverage is 2 routes of 194, agenda only (src/api/concurrency.ts).

This is the most checkable false claim we ship and the API serves it about itself. Fix: narrow the sentence to the truth (agenda mutations carry strong ETag/If-Match) or delete it. If narrowing, consider documenting the If-Match header parameter on the two agenda operations that genuinely take it, so the spec and the sentence agree.

2. SKILL.md IS NOT SERVED. GET /SKILL.md, /llms.txt and /.well-known/ai-plugin.json all return the SPA shell (the catch-all at src/index.ts serves ASSETS for every unmatched path, so a 200 proves nothing). SKILL.md is a repo artifact only. Serving it turns 'ships in the repo' into 'an agent can fetch it from your deployment' — the brief bonus is for an API, and nothing asks for an agent skill at all, so this is unasked-for surface worth making real. Add the route to run_worker_first in wrangler.jsonc if needed (see how /claim/* was fixed in PR #111).

VERIFY AFTER DEPLOY: curl -s .../api/openapi.json | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['info']['description'])" and curl -s .../SKILL.md | head -3 (must be markdown, not doctype html).

Evidence: sequence/research/DIFFERENTIATION-MATRIX.md, honesty ledger items 1 and 4.
data.title: The API overclaims optimistic concurrency, and SKILL.md is unreachable

data.body: Plan authored: narrow the OpenAPI claim, document the two agenda If-Match headers, serve the canonical root SKILL.md through a Worker route plus run_worker_first, then run focused checks, check:api, and the exact-head PR gate.

Observed final exact-head local Worker at http://127.0.0.1:59246/ (build b75a56af4dca): curl /api/openapi.json reported the narrowed description, If-Match occurrences: 1, and declared If-Match operations removeAgendaItem/updateAgendaItem (header parameters: 2). curl /SKILL.md | head -3 returned '# Marquee', a blank line, then the canonical Marquee skill sentence; response content-type was text/markdown; charset=utf-8, not the SPA shell. npx tsc --noEmit, focused meta (6/6), focused agenda (9/9), production build, and npm run check:api passed. The full pr-gate pre-suite checks passed, but its hermetic suite timed out after 610.460s under shared fleet load with unrelated baseline failures; it is not reported as green.

Final exact HEAD b8dcfd727693 is based on current github/main 2ec270514c39 and pushed to github/mrq-146-honesty. Focused Worker validation passed: meta + agenda files, 15/15 tests; npx tsc --noEmit passed; npm run trace:ac -- --scope=merged passed with zero errors. Local Worker curl evidence already recorded the narrowed OpenAPI description, exact If-Match count 1, two declared agenda if-match operations, and markdown /SKILL.md. Per shared-fleet guidance, full local pr-gate was stopped and is not treated as a verdict; CI fast-gate is authoritative. Draft PR: https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/marquee/pull/130

PR #130 is open as a draft at https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/marquee/pull/130, exact head b8dcfd727693. GitHub CI/fast-gate is pending; no further local gate work will run. The local worktree is clean and no MRQ-146 dev/gate process remains.

Merged PR #130 at commit 85e17150ea47 after CI fast-gate passed and the exact-head single-mode code review returned PASS with three non-blocking observations. Changes narrow the OpenAPI concurrency claim, document the two agenda If-Match headers, and serve canonical SKILL.md as markdown before the SPA catch-all. Focused validation passed 15/15 tests, TypeScript, and merged trace:ac. No deployment was performed; live health remains build 1f53732201aa and must be redeployed separately.
